title: Compilation, ABI, and EVM Fundamentals
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Compilation, ABI, and EVM Fundamentals and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 10: Compilation, ABI, and EVM Fundamentals; it lists all 15 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 10 roadmap: How Solidity Compilation Works; Source Code, Intermediate Representation, and Bytecode; ABI: Application Binary Interface; Function Selectors and Calldata Encoding; Decoding Return Data and Revert Data; Events and Topics at the EVM Level; EVM Stack, Memory, and Storage; Contract Creation and Runtime Bytecode; Opcodes and EVM Instruction Execution; Gas Accounting and Execution Limits; Compiler Optimization Settings; Selecting an EVM Target Version; Compiler Warnings and Known Compiler Bugs; Source Maps and Debugging Information; Reading Compilation Artifacts. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.

notes: Preserves numbered syllabus topics 116–130 from the attached Solidity PDF. Track: core. All content is draft pending subject-matter review.
